question: Can the official DENR/CENRO-named Lopez marsh sites be linked to the verified PSA municipality code without resolving wetland identity or inventing geometry?
method: Reconciled the existing CENRO crosswalk against its official indexed source wording and the PSA PSGC municipality table. Replaced province-only associations with the exact source-described barangay locality and Lopez municipality code. Kept all three waterbodies as research leads; no feature identity, boundary, fish occurrence, or public claim was inferred.
